title: A Very Dear Cat
question: Why was Rastus 'very dear' in more ways than one?

meanings.usage: 指参与绑架他人的人，通常为了索要赎金
强调数量或程度之大，常用于正式语境
形容拥有大量财富的人，是rich的正式表达
形容事物有条理、有规则，也可指人守秩序
disappear的名词形式，指某人或某物不见的情况
指不透露身份或姓名的，常用于信件、捐款等
绑架案中要求支付的金钱，作为释放人质的条件
正式用语，指给出明确的指示或命令
指从银行账户中取出资金，也可用作收回承诺等
准时地，强调时间的精确性，是punctual的副词形式
语气比surprise更强，表示极度惊讶
指用于制作盒子等的厚纸材料
英式英语，指同一层楼的公寓套房
双重含义：1.表示亲爱的、珍贵的 2.表示价格高的；本课利用这双关
指与他人共同使用或拥有某物

examples.en: They recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Ramsay's cat.
examples.zh: 他们最近对拉姆齐夫人的猫非常感兴趣。

phrases.usage: 安全；处于可信赖的人手中

examples.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 写信人称拉斯塔斯很安全。

examples.en: She changed her mind and decided to pay the ransom.
examples.zh: 她改变了主意，决定支付赎金。

examples.en: Mrs. Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
examples.zh: 拉姆齐夫人确信绑匪会遵守诺言。

examples.en: She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.
examples.zh: 她到处找他，但找不到。

examples.en: She withdrew money and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
examples.zh: 她取了钱并按照绑匪的指示行事。

examples.en: Rastus leads an orderly life.
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯过着有规律的生活。

phrases.usage: 不止一种方式；多方面地

examples.en: Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.zh: 考虑到她付出的金额，拉斯塔斯多方面都很珍贵！

phrases.usage: 对某人来说很珍贵/亲爱的

examples.en: Rastus was very dear to her.
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。

examples.en: The letter had made that quite clear.
examples.zh: 信里已经把这一点说得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: Kidnappers are rarely interested in animals, but they recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Eleanor Ramsay's cat.
sentences.zh: 绑架者极少对动物感兴趣，但他们最近却对埃莉诺·拉姆齐夫人的猫产生了极大兴趣。

sentences.en: Mrs. Eleanor Ramsay, a very wealthy old lady, has shared a flat with her cat, Rastus, for a great many years.
sentences.zh: 埃莉诺·拉姆齐夫人，一位非常富有的老太太，与她的猫拉斯特斯共同住在一个公寓里已经很多年了。
拉斯特斯过着有规律的生活。

sentences.en: He usually takes a short walk in the evenings and is always home by seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 它通常在傍晚散步一小会儿，总是在7点钟前到家。

sentences.en: One evening, however, he failed to arrive.
sentences.zh: 然而，一天晚上，它没有回来。

sentences.en: She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.
sentences.zh: 她到处寻找，但没有找到它。

sentences.en: Three days after Rastus' disappearance, Mrs. Ramsay received an anonymous letter.
sentences.zh: 拉斯特斯失踪3天后，拉姆齐夫人收到一封匿名信。

sentences.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000.
sentences.zh: 写信人称拉斯特斯很安全，如果拉姆齐夫人支付1000英镑赎金，它将立即被送回。

sentences.en: Mrs.Ramsay was instructed to place the money in a cardboard box and to leave it outside her door.
sentences.zh: 拉姆齐夫人被指示将钱放进一个纸箱，并将其放在门外。

sentences.en: At first, she decided to go to the police,
but fearing that she would never see Rastus again--the letter had made that quite clear--she changed her mind.
sentences.zh: 但由于担心再也见不到拉斯特斯——信中已把这一点说得一清二楚——她改变了主意。

sentences.en: She withdrew ￡1000 from her bank and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
sentences.zh: 她从银行取出1000英镑，按照绑架者的指示做了。

sentences.en: The next morning, the box had disappeared but Mrs.Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，箱子不见了，但拉姆齐夫人确信绑架者会遵守诺言。

sentences.en: Sure enough, Rastus arrived punctually at seven o'clock that evening.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，拉斯特斯那天晚上7点准时回来了。

sentences.en: He looked very well, though he was rather thirsty, for he drank half a bottle of milk.
sentences.zh: 它看上去很好，只是有点渴，喝了半瓶牛奶。

sentences.en: The police were astounded when Mrs. Ramsay told them what she had done.
sentences.zh: 当拉姆齐夫人告诉警察她所做的一切时，警察都惊呆了。

sentences.en: She explained that Rastus was very dear to her.
sentences.zh: 她解释说拉斯特斯对她来说非常宝贵。

sentences.en: Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
sentences.zh: 考虑到她所支付的金额，它在多方面都确实很“名贵”！

exercises.prompt: “相当大的；相当多的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: considerable · /kənˈsɪdərəbl/ · adjective · 相当大的；相当多的。强调数量或程度之大，常用于正式语境

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：失踪；消失
exercises.explain: disappearance · /ˌdɪsəˈpɪərəns/ · noun · 失踪；消失。disappear的名词形式，指某人或某物不见的情况

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：Considering the amount she paid, he was dear _____!
exercises.hint: 考虑到她付出的金额，拉斯塔斯多方面都很珍贵！
exercises.explain: in more ways than one：不止一种方式；多方面地（考虑到她付出的金额，拉斯塔斯多方面都很珍贵！）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：The writer _____ that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000.
exercises.hint: 写信人称拉斯特斯很安全，如果拉姆齐夫人支付1000英镑赎金，它将立即被送回。
exercises.explain: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000. — 写信人称拉斯特斯很安全，如果拉姆齐夫人支付1000英镑赎金，它将立即被送回。

source.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000.

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作，常与when、while等连用” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: no matter what引导的让步状语从句
动词不定式作表语 (Infinitive as Predicative)
exercises.explain: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)：主语 + was/were + 动词-ing：用于描述过去正在发生的动作背景，或与一般过去时连用表示过去某事发生时有另一动作在进行

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000.
options: 同时，他创办了一所非常成功的拳击学院，甚至拜伦勋爵也成了他的学生之一。

后来我们沿着村里的主要街道走去，一群默默无声的孩子跟在我们后面。
写信人称拉斯特斯很安全，如果拉姆齐夫人支付1000英镑赎金，它将立即被送回。
exercises.explain: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000. — 写信人称拉斯特斯很安全，如果拉姆齐夫人支付1000英镑赎金，它将立即被送回。

source.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of ￡1,000.

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作，常与when、while等连用
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去正在发生的动作背景，或与一般过去时连用表示过去某事发生时有另一动作在进行

examples.en: One evening, however, he failed to arrive.
examples.zh: 然而，有一天晚上，他没有按时回家。

grammar.title: 条件状语从句 (Conditional Clause)
grammar.definition: 由if引导的条件句，表达假设的情况及其可能的结果
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 过去式, 主语 + would/could + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于谈论不太可能发生的假设情况，或与过去事实相反的虚拟语气

examples.en: She decided to go to the police, but fearing that she would never see Rastus again, she changed her mind.
examples.zh: 她本想去报警，但又担心再也见不到拉斯塔斯了，于是改变了主意。

grammar.title: 双关语 (Pun)
grammar.definition: 利用词语的多义性或同音异义词创造幽默效果的修辞手法
grammar.structure: 同一个词在不同语境下有不同含义
grammar.usage: 用于创造幽默效果，本课中'dear'既表示'亲爱的'又表示'昂贵的'，形成文字游戏

examples.en: Rastus was very dear to her. Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。考虑到她付出的金额，他多方面都很值钱！

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has shared + 名词 + with + 某人 + for + 时间段

original.en: Mrs. Eleanor Ramsay has shared a flat with her cat for a great many years.
original.zh: 埃莱娜·拉姆齐夫人和她的猫拉斯塔斯已经共同居住在一套公寓里很多年了。

examples.en: He has shared an office with his brother for five years.
examples.zh: 他和哥哥已经共用一间办公室五年了。

examples.en: Mary has shared a room with her sister since childhood.
examples.zh: 玛丽从小就和妹妹同住一个房间。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was + 形容词, though + 主语 + 动词

original.en: He looked very well, though he was rather thirsty.
original.zh: 他看起来很健康，虽然相当口渴。

examples.en: She seemed happy, though she was actually quite tired.
examples.zh: 她看起来很开心，虽然实际上很累。

examples.en: The book was interesting, though it was a bit long.
examples.zh: 这本书很有趣，虽然有点长。

original.en: Sure enough, Rastus arrived punctually at seven o'clock that evening.
original.zh: 果然，拉斯塔斯那天晚上准时七点回来了。

examples.en: The train arrived exactly at nine o'clock as expected.
examples.zh: 火车正如预期的那样准时九点到达。

examples.en: He came right on time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 他正好准时来开会。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + explained that + 从句

original.en: She explained that Rastus was very dear to her.
original.zh: 她解释说拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。

examples.en: He explained that the project would take another month.
examples.zh: 他解释这个项目还需要一个月。

examples.en: The teacher explained that the exam would be next Friday.
examples.zh: 老师解释说考试将在下周五进行。
